summary: the cosmological tower as ONE dated point in the (n_s, r) plane. The substrate predicts (n_s, r) = (1-1/beat, 1/(Phi_4 beat)) = (0.9667, 1/300), the N = 2 beat = 60 point on the Starobinsky line r = 3(1-n_s)^2 -- a point on a known one-parameter curve, with N=60 the location. Current (Planck + BK 2021): n_s 0.42 sigma high, r < 0.036, consistent. Forecast (CMB-S4/LiteBIRD, sigma(n_s)~0.002, sigma(r)~0.0005): r detected at 6.7 sigma, the point pinned to a tiny ellipse, N measured to sigma(N) = (N^2/2)sigma(n_s) = 3.6 (N = 60 +/- 3.6), testing N=2 beat=60 vs N=50 at 2.8 sigma. So by the mid-2030s the tower is confirmed as the Starobinsky N=60 point or excluded. A TikZ figure (analysis/w33_ns_r_forecast_fig.tex) shows the Starobinsky line, the substrate point, the Planck n_s band, and the CMB-S4 ellipse. HONEST: the point and line-membership are exact; sigma(n_s), sigma(r) are published sensitivities (realised values depend on foregrounds/delensing). The packaging of Passes 6-11 into one falsifiable plot, not a new prediction.
